title: Production Druid property completeness gate
reason: Production YAML must fail closed whenever DruidProperties adds a required @Value key without a matching profile value.
oldRule: Production safety validates environment placeholders, unsafe defaults, disabled consoles, and anonymous Druid access, but does not compare Java-required Druid @Value keys with application-prod.yml.
newRule: Both normal and production safety validation dynamically extract every required Druid @Value key from Java source and fail when the production YAML lacks the exact nested path.
regressionContract: Delete each real required key individually and require a failure.
Add a synthetic future @Value key to Java source and require a failure without changing the checker.
Keep the existing safe production fixture green when every extracted key is present.
Ignore deceptive @Value text in Java comments, strings, and text blocks while rejecting unsupported active syntax and invalid lexer terminal states.
Reject null, container, empty, and whitespace values while accepting leaf and intermediate-map scalar aliases, false, and zero.
Run the checker through the existing npm run check wiring.
verification: Focused production safety tests pass 47/47 after four RED stages.
Both check:config-safety and check:prod-safety pass on the repository.
The complete npm run check passes with 426/426 Node tests.
